question: How much higher the average intrinsic value is for trades using the feeling-lucky strategy compared to those using the momentum strategy under long-side trades?
sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN LastPx - StrikePrice ELSE NULL END) AS feeling_lucky_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN LastPx - StrikePrice ELSE NULL END) AS momentum_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN LastPx - StrikePrice ELSE NULL END) - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN LastPx - StrikePrice ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`, UNNEST(Sides) AS s
WHERE s.Side = 'LONG'
  AND (TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' OR TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%')
